CustomField.description: Instalment sales: amount due each month (amount on instalment divided by the duration; uses the minimum 30% deposit until a down payment is agreed).
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(Payment_Mode__c, "Instalment"), Instalment_Term_Months__c > 0), (Sale_Price__c - BLANKVALUE(Instalment_Down_Payment__c, 0.3 * Sale_Price__c)) / Instalment_Term_Months__c, NULL)
CustomField.label: AM Monthly Instalment
